title: Studio Data › Actions: a "Run a script" action is saved without `type`, so the console treats it as not executable — clicking it sends no request
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The builder writes a script action, publishes, and the button in the app does nothing (or shows its error toast / "not executable: no handler is registered…"). The server endpoint works; only the stored shape is incomplete.

## Reproduction

1. Data › Actions › New › Advanced › New action → What it does "Run a script" → write a body. Draft: `{name:"run_script", body:{…}}`, no `type`.
2. Publish; in the app click it → no request; toast is the action's errorMessage, or for `gated` "Action \"gated\" is not executable: no handler is registered under that name and it declares no api, endpoint, navigate, redirect or onClick."
3. `POST /api/v1/actions/gapdata_item/run_script` → 200. Adding `type: "script"` via the API makes the button work.

## Expected

Studio writes `type: "script"` when the builder chooses a script.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` (the Type select shows Script as its default but never commits it).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio + console, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Script actions are the common custom action; Studio-made ones are dead on arrival.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio script action saved without type, console says not executable no handler registered` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 4 hits, all closed and about other paths (#21321, #14145, #4343, #3915).
- QA id: G2
